title: One-pot synthesis of thermally reversible materials using maleimide-polysaccharide and furan-lignin derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28255-28268
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02344K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Valentin Silveira, Raffaello Papadakis, Stergios Adamopoulos
The bio-based materials potato starch (St) and Kraft lignin (KL) were chemically modified to create a thermally responsive network through a reversible Diels–Alder (DA) reaction between maleimide and furan groups grafted on St and KL, respectively.
